results.test: ESM and CommonJS expose the same independent runtime
State projected and mapped binding preserve sibling properties
State subscriptions unsubscribe and ignore equal identity
Conditional dependencies detach when branch changes
Computed binding is read-only and disposable
Constant bindings reject mutations by retaining original value
Scopes cancel events and children once in reverse ownership order
Owned timers cannot outlive a disposed scope
Environment children inherit then override reactive values
UndoManager retains snapshots, supports redo and rolls back exceptions
No-op transactions do not consume undo history
Fluent view modifiers leave original descriptors unchanged
Validated declarative views compile bindings and named actions
View documents reject duplicate IDs and unknown components
Data validation rejects pollution keys and nonfinite values
